The other day I helped my mom bake a cake, and I helped her bake the frosting and all. When I was 13, I never would of done that, I would have just sit down and eat the cake.  it was nice to help her.  i am not saying I am not still 13 on the inside, because I am, but I am older now and can do more things than when I was 13, and that makes me feel good.

I'm going to be 16 this year, and I know next year I will be 17, and the next year I will be 18 and then I will be a grown up.
